select FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TYPE payType, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE_VAL payCycleVal, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CALC_RULE calcRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate from FIN_CASH_INFO, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE, FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
and FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and ( FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
